style_direction: Andean high-dimensional editorial comic. Keep the lecture visually polished, academic, warm, and intentional. Preserve the slide structure and all teaching meaning.
negative_constraints: Preserve chart geometry, equations, and labels.
Do not add logos, signatures, or watermarks.
Do not change the 16:9 slide aspect ratio.
Do not crop or remove key teaching content.
